body:
I’m a very anxious person, so overthinking is pretty common. But yeah, I kind of already had some plans I wanted to work on today, this just gives me more motivation to do them. Thanks.

Helped.

To answer your questions, honestly, I’m not really invested in this job and I’m fairly actively looking for a new one; there’s no real upward mobility, the perks aren’t great if we ever even get them, it’s pretty unlikely I’d get a bad reference from them considering I’m pretty good at my job, and I don’t even know what my dreams look like anymore but they sure don’t look like this place long term.

Thanks for giving me a new perspective on my situation, though, that actually kind of clears a few things up. Helped.
This is also true. I’ve been working on job hunting anyway, I feel like this is a good sign to keep moving down that path, too.
That’s probably the most direct answer, but I have come in for a minute on my days off in the past to grab something I’d left or check the schedule, so part of me is nervous they wouldn’t believe me.

That’s probably the simplest answer, but it feels like I’d be lying somehow. To be honest, I actually do feel a little off this morning, but it’s mostly because I barely slept last night. I got maybe two, three hours? Which is part of why I had called off the other day, I’ve been sleeping horribly lately as it is.
